create.name: Trisha McCagh
create.bio:
Trisha McCagh is an Australian animal communicator, teacher and author based in Western Australia, and the founder of Animal Talk. She trained and worked in dental health before turning to animal communication, a change she traces to her bond with her cat Beau, and she studied with animal communication teachers in the United States and the United Kingdom. She describes her work as listening to the "silent language" of animals, and has worked with wildlife and taught children and adults in Africa.

She offers consultations by phone and Zoom, including readings to connect with animals that have died, and teaches through the Animal Talk Institute: the self-paced Pet Talk Program, a recorded class on grief after losing a pet, and a twelve-month Certified Practitioner Program for people who want to work professionally. She also leads small-group wildlife tours. Her book Stories from the Animal Whisperer gathers case stories from her practice, and she hosts the Animal Talk with Trisha McCagh podcast. She has appeared on Australian television programmes such as Studio 10, Sunrise and A Current Affair.

books.title: Stories from the Animal Whisperer: What Your Pet Is Thinking and Trying to Tell You
books.author: Trisha McCagh
books.description: True stories from her work as an animal communicator with pets, horses and wild animals. Each story shows what she believes the animal was trying to say and how that changed things for its people.

courses.title: Pet Talk Program
courses.description: A self-paced online course in two-way communication with your own animals, in three stages: understanding, finding inner silence and making the connection. It includes videos, audio tracks, workbooks and a bonus course on quietening the mind.

courses.title: Overcoming Grief of a Beloved Pet
courses.description: A 90-minute recorded class for people who have lost an animal companion. It covers her view of the animal afterlife and exercises for feeling connected to a pet after it has died.

courses.title: Animal Talk Certified Practitioner Program
courses.description: A twelve-month online training for people who want to work as animal communicators, with twelve monthly modules, fortnightly live coaching calls with Trisha and supervised practice with clients. It ends with an assessment and certification.

courses.title: Private Animal Communication Consultations
courses.description: One-to-one sessions by phone or Zoom in which she relays what your animal is communicating. Rainbow Bridge readings with animals that have died and Pet Soul Purpose readings are also offered.

flags: Her field is animal communication, which none of the Spiritpedia subjects fits well; I used consciousness, mediumship-spirits and spirituality. A human may want to check she belongs on the site.

Only one photo could be confirmed (Shift Network headshot, 300 px). Her YouTube avatar is the Animal Talk logo, and the photo of a woman with a lion on her homepage is probably her but I couldn't be sure.
Her own YouTube videos are mostly short TV segments and promo clips with very few views; the five kept are the ones closest to teaching or demonstration.

The Pet Talk Program sales page on animaltalk.com.au says the method can help animals with emotional or physical trauma and pain; the course page itself makes no such claim, so I kept the course and left those claims out of the description.
She is based in Quinns Rock, Western Australia; I set availability to worldwide because consultations and courses are by phone, Zoom and online.
